executionPolicy.taskSelection: Select the lowest-numbered pending task whose dependencies are completed.
executionPolicy.completionRule: Mark a task completed only after all acceptance criteria pass and every listed validation has been run.
executionPolicy.compatibility: Preserve existing public exports and AgentInput behavior unless a task explicitly introduces a validated extension.
scope: Implement deliverables under native-classifiers/src unless another path is explicitly listed.
Add focused tests under native-classifiers/test for every behavior change.
Do not implement edit, build, test, shell, or other mutating analysis handlers.
Do not expose secrets found while inventorying, searching, reading, or reporting repository content.
Do not claim a code relationship unless it is represented by captured evidence or clearly labeled as inferred.

acceptanceCriteria: Supports architecture, feature_flow, symbol_usage, data_flow, dependency, and error_path modes
